title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
方言听到周仲英如此说，当下就做出一副羞愧难当的样子：“若不是我四嫂……对了，我四嫂平日最是温柔，此番性情大变，定是我四哥那里出了变故！方才见我四嫂神色仓皇，像是被什么人追赶，同行的又不见我四哥，怕是真的出了什么意外！”周仲英一想也是如此，自己纵横江湖，处处与人为善，轻易不得罪人，可是方才那女子眼中的仇恨做不得假，定是庄上出了变故，害了文四当家。想到这里，周仲英顿时心急如焚，恨不得立刻赶到庄子。于是，他对着方言一抱拳：“方少侠，还请随我回庄子里，看看究竟发生了何事！”方言连忙道：“固所愿也，不敢请耳！”几人拍马急奔，不多一会儿就回到了铁胆庄。庄子里的人神色各异，周仲英叫来人一问，立刻就从众人的七嘴八舌中得知了事情的真相。原来，刚才恰逢官兵搜捕，文泰来三人躲在地窖，被官兵瓮中捉鳖，一网打尽。文泰来拼死给妻子和兄弟打出一条生路，这才有了路上遇见骆冰的那一幕。“他们躲在地窖里，官兵是如何发现的？！！”周仲英又气又急。自家的地窖极为隐秘，如果不是庄子里的人告密，官兵又怎能发现？怪不得骆女侠一见面就对我下杀手，想必是以为我出卖了他们！随即他就勃然大怒，当着方言的面，手中的鞭子劈头盖脸的朝着庄丁打去。“好狗贼，还不快说，究竟是谁走漏了风声？”庄丁们躲又不敢躲，说也不敢说。周仲英心中咯噔一下。看庄丁们这副样子，走漏消息的，怕不是真的和自己身边的人有关！当下也不再逼问庄丁，怒气冲冲地走向内院。此时，适逢大弟子孟建雄护着周仲英的妻子和一双儿女过来。“建雄，你说！是谁出卖了红花会的朋友？”周仲英脸上怒气冲天，像是要吃人。孟建雄犹豫了一下说道：“是官兵自己发现的。”周仲英怒极反笑：“放屁，地窖如此隐秘，官兵如何能发现？”孟建雄犹犹豫豫不肯说话。周仲英挥鞭就打，孟建雄闭着眼睛，任凭身上被抽的皮开肉绽也不松口。“师父……不关大师兄的事……”一旁的三弟子宋善朋不忍孟建雄被打，颤抖着声音就要说实话。孟建雄却突然睁开眼睛，怒视宋善鹏。宋善鹏撇过头去，用微弱的声音说道：“是……是小公子说的……”周仲英心里登时一个咯噔，转头瞪着自己的小儿子周英杰，怒吼道：“孽畜，你过来！！！”周英杰畏畏缩缩的靠过来，眼神躲闪，不敢看自己的父亲。周仲英厉声喝问：“小畜生，三位客人躲在地窖里的事情，是你告诉官兵的？”

周英杰平日里最怕这个严厉的父亲，向来不敢说谎。可是他也没胆子承认，只是低着头不说话。周仲英见状，扬起手中的鞭子，大声吼道：“你说是不说？”见到事情瞒不住了，孟建雄连忙上前拦住周仲英，替周英杰解释道：“官差欺小公子年幼，用言语相激，这才套出话来。”周仲英脸上怒气更盛，再加上方言又在一旁看着，忍不住就要狠狠的教训周英杰。孟建雄连忙用身体拦住，同时用眼神示意师娘将小公子带进去。周仲英的妻子赶紧拉着小儿子就要离开。周仲英看见儿子就要消失在门廊，自己又被大徒弟死死地抱住不得动弹，气急之下，手中的铁胆登时就朝着门廊甩去！周仲英本是发泄之举，可是没曾想道，周英杰竟在此时突然转身朝着他冲了过来，想扑在父亲怀里撒娇求饶。这一下，本来只是打中院墙的铁胆，有一枚登时就朝着周英杰的脑袋飞去！“啊——”周仲英目眦欲裂，眼睁睁的看着铁胆即将砸碎自己儿子的脑袋！就在这时，周仲英眼角的余光一闪，一个人影突然出现在奔跑的周英杰身边，伸手一挡！只听到啪啪的两声轻响，铁胆被一个修长的手掌握住，然后手背重重的撞在周英杰的脸颊上！周英杰痛呼一声，一口鲜血带着两个后槽牙飞了出来，整个人也被那沛然巨力扇飞，摔倒在地上，痛哭不已。周仲英的心猛地抽搐一下，随后又砰砰砰的跳个不停。他一掌拍开了孟建雄，快步走到儿子面前查看他的伤势。只见周英杰右脸肿胀，一片血红，嘴巴里还有混浊的鲜血混着唾沫不断流下，鼻涕眼泪随着号啕声不断涌出。她的妻子这时候也反应过来，尖叫一声快步上前，抱着周英杰哭嚎不止。周仲英悬着的心这才放了下来，还能哭，说明没事！他这时候才感觉到一阵后怕，这还是被肉掌阻了一下，要是没人阻拦，周英杰的头颅势必会被铁胆打个稀巴烂，当场身死，神仙难救！看着另一个已经镶嵌在砖墙里的铁胆就知道，刚才自己的含怒一击，究竟有多大的力道！如果不是他，自己可能就真的杀了自己的儿子了！周仲英望向了一旁不断甩着手的方言，心中的感激之情无以复加！“多谢方少侠救下犬子的性命！”周仲英快步走到方言身前，一撩下袍，双膝跪地就要拜下！方言连忙用那只完好的手扶住了周仲英，用力将他搀起来。周仲英哪里肯站起来，当下运起内力就要挣脱方言的搀扶，结结实实的给方言磕头。可是谁知，方言的胳膊就像是铁铸一般，任凭周仲英如何用力，还是被方言硬生生的给扶起来。周仲英心下骇然，这个年轻人难道上辈子就开始修炼了吗？自己几十年的内力，居然比不过他一个弱冠青年？！！！方言扶起周仲英后，诚恳地说道：“周庄主莫要行此大礼，这不是在折我的寿吗？！！”周仲英心中又羞又愧，自己儿子出卖了红花会的好汉，方言却能不计前嫌救下自己的儿子。这是何等的胸襟与气魄啊！
content_en:
When Fang Yan heard what Zhou Zhongying said, he immediately looked ashamed: "If it weren't for my fourth sister-in-law... By the way, my fourth sister-in-law is usually the most gentle. This sudden change in temperament must be due to something happening with my fourth brother! I just saw that my fourth sister-in-law looked in a hurry, as if she was being chased by someone., and my fourth brother is missing from the company, I'm afraid something really happened!" Zhou Zhongying thought the same thing, he was always kind to others, and he didn't offend anyone easily, but the hatred in the woman's eyes just now cannot be faked, something must have happened at the village, which harmed Master Wen Si.Thinking of this, Zhou Zhongying suddenly became anxious and wanted to rush to Zhuangzi immediately.So, he cupped his fist at Fang Yan and said, "Young Master Fang, please follow me back to the village to see what happened!" Fang Yan said quickly, "I have my wish, but I don't dare to ask for help!" Several people clapped their horses and ran quickly, and returned to Tiedan Village in a short while.The people in Zhuangzi had different expressions. When Zhou Zhongying called someone to ask, he immediately learned the truth from everyone's chatter.It turned out that the officers and soldiers had just been searching for them. Wen Tailai and the other three were hiding in the cellar, and they were caught in a jar by the officers and soldiers, and they were all caught in one fell swoop.Wen Tailai tried his best to find a way out for his wife and brother, and that's when he met Luo Bing on the road."They were hiding in the cellar, how did the officers and soldiers find out?!" Zhou Zhongying was angry and anxious.His cellar is extremely secretive. How could the officers and soldiers discover it if someone in Zhuangzi hadn't reported it?No wonder Luo Nuxia killed me as soon as they met. She must have thought I betrayed them!Then he became furious and hit Zhuang Ding with the whip in front of Fang Yan."Good thief, why don't you tell me who leaked the news?" The villagers hid but did not dare to hide, and did not dare to tell.Zhou Zhongying's heart skipped a beat.Looking at the appearance of the villagers, whoever leaked the news might not really be related to the people around them!At that moment, he stopped questioning Zhuang Ding and walked towards the inner courtyard angrily.At this time, the eldest disciple Meng Jianxiong came over to protect Zhou Zhongying's wife and two children."Jianxiong, tell me! Who betrayed the friends of the Red Flower Club?" Zhou Zhongying's face was full of anger, as if he wanted to eat people.Meng Jianxiong hesitated and said, "The officers and soldiers discovered it themselves." Zhou Zhongying laughed angrily: "Fart, the cellar is so secret, how could the officers and soldiers find it?" Meng Jianxiong hesitated and refused to speak.Zhou Zhongying whipped him while Meng Jianxiong closed his eyes and refused to let go even though his skin and flesh were torn."Master...it's none of Senior Brother's business..." Song Shanpeng, the third disciple on the side, couldn't bear Meng Jianxiong being beaten and wanted to tell the truth with a trembling voice.Meng Jianxiong suddenly opened his eyes and glared at Song Shanpeng.Song Shanpeng turned his head away and said in a weak voice: "Yes... the young master said..." Zhou Zhongying's heart suddenly skipped a beat, and he turned to glare at his youngest son Zhou Yingjie and roared: "You evil beast, come here!!!" Zhou Yingjie came over timidly, his eyes evasive, not daring to look at his father.Zhou Zhongying asked sternly: "Little beast, did you tell the officers and soldiers about the three guests hiding in the cellar?"

Zhou Yingjie was usually most afraid of his stern father and never dared to lie.But he didn't have the guts to admit it, he just lowered his head and said nothing.Seeing this, Zhou Zhongying raised the whip in his hand and shouted loudly: "You said you didn't tell me?" Seeing that he couldn't hide the matter, Meng Jianxiong quickly stepped forward to stop Zhou Zhongying and explained to Zhou Yingjie: "The official bullied the young master and used words to provoke him, so he came up with the words." Zhou Zhongying's face became even more angry, and Fang Yan was watching from the side, and he couldn't help but teach Zhou Yingjie a lesson.Meng Jianxiong quickly stopped him with his body, and at the same time motioned his wife with his eyes to bring the young master inside.Zhou Zhongying's wife quickly took her young son and was about to leave.Zhou Zhongying saw that his son was about to disappear on the porch, and he was hugged tightly by his eldest disciple, unable to move. In anger, he immediately threw the iron gall in his hand towards the porch!Zhou Zhongying originally wanted to vent his anger, but he never thought that Zhou Yingjie suddenly turned around and rushed towards him, wanting to throw himself into his father's arms and beg for mercy.This time, one of the iron galls that was originally just hitting the middle courtyard wall flew towards Zhou Yingjie's head!"Ah——" Zhou Zhongying's eyes were splitting as he watched helplessly as Tie Dan was about to smash his son's head!At this moment, out of the corner of Zhou Zhongying's eyes, a figure suddenly appeared beside the running Zhou Yingjie, reaching out to block him!Only two soft popping sounds were heard. Tiedan was held by a slender hand, and then the back of the hand hit Zhou Yingjie's cheek heavily!Zhou Yingjie screamed in pain, and a mouthful of blood flew out with his two back molars. His whole body was blown away by the huge force, and he fell to the ground, crying bitterly.Zhou Zhongying's heart twitched suddenly, and then started pounding again.He slapped Meng Jianxiong away and quickly walked to his son to check his injuries.I saw that the right side of Zhou Yingjie's face was swollen and bloody. There was turbid blood mixed with saliva flowing down from his mouth, and his nose and tears kept pouring out along with the howling sound.Her wife also reacted at this time, screamed and stepped forward quickly, hugging Zhou Yingjie and crying non-stop.Zhou Zhongying's worried heart was relieved, and he could still cry, which meant it was okay!Only then did he feel frightened, but he was blocked by the flesh palm. If no one stopped him, Zhou Yingjie's head would be beaten to pieces by the iron gallbladder, and he would die on the spot. It would be hard for gods to save him!Looking at the other iron gall that has been embedded in the brick wall, I know how powerful my angry blow just now was!If it hadn't been for him, he might have actually killed his own son!Zhou Zhongying looked at Fang Yan, who kept waving his hands, and the gratitude in his heart could not be greater!"Thank you, Shaoxia Fang, for saving Quanzi's life!" Zhou Zhongying walked quickly to Fang Yan, lifted up his robe, knelt down and bowed down!Fang Yan quickly used his good hand to support Zhou Zhongying and helped him up.Where Zhou Zhongying is willing to stand up, when he musters up his inner strength, he must break away from Fang Yan's support and kowtow to Fang Yan firmly.But who would have thought that Fang Yan's arms were as if they were made of iron. No matter how hard Zhou Zhongying tried, Fang Yan was still able to help him up.Zhou Zhongying was horrified. Did this young man start practicing cultivation in his previous life?With decades of internal strength, he could not compare to a weak young man like him?!!!After Fang Yan helped Zhou Zhongying up, he said sincerely: "Zhuang Master Zhou, please don't give me such a big gift. Isn't this shortening my life?!" Zhou Zhongying felt ashamed and ashamed. His son betrayed the heroes of the Red Flower Society, but Fang Yan was able to save his son regardless of the previous grudges.What kind of mind and courage is this!
